mapper.select:
SELECT page.* FROM ( SELECT b.ORDER_NO, b.DEVICE_ID, b.TRANS_TYPE, b.ADMIN_TRANS_TYPE, b.OPERATER_ID, b.SHIFT_ID, b.CARD_ID, b.TRANS_AOUNT, b.STATUS, b.MSG, b.PAYMENT_CODE, b.PAYMENT_VENDOR, b.CHANNEL, b.PAYCENTER_ORDERNO, b.PAYCENTER_CHANNELORDERNO, b.RSV2, b.CREATE_TIME, b.UPDATE_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.CREATE_TIME DESC, b.ORDER_NO DESC) AS rn FROM TBL_BOM_ORDER_PAY b
) page WHERE page.rn > #{offset} AND page.rn <= #{offsetEnd}

SELECT SUBSTR(b.CREATE_TIME, 1, 10) AS STAT_DATE, COUNT(1) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN b.STATUS = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PAID_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN b.RSV2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REFUND_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN b.STATUS = '1' THEN NVL(TO_NUMBER(b.TRANS_AOUNT), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS PAID_TRANS_AMOUNT_SUM FROM TBL_BOM_ORDER_PAY b WHERE b.TRANS_TYPE = '22' AND b.CREATE_TIME >= #{dateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.CREATE_TIME <= #{dateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY SUBSTR(b.CREATE_TIME, 1, 10) ORDER BY STAT_DATE

select bom.ORDER_NO,bom.TRANS_AOUNT from ( (select from TBL_BOM_ORDER_PAY where STATUS = '1' and TRANS_TYPE = #{transType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rsv2 is null and CREATE_TIME between #{startTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) bom left join (select * from tbl_bom_main_ticket) main on bom.ORDER_NO = main.ORDER_NO) where main.ORDER_NO is null

select bom.ORDER_NO,bom.TRANS_AOUNT from ( (select from TBL_BOM_ORDER_PAY where STATUS = '1' and TRANS_TYPE = #{transType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rsv2 is null and CREATE_TIME between #{startTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) bom left join (select * from TBL_BOM_TOPUP_RESULT) topup on bom.ORDER_NO = topup.ORDER_NO) where topup.ORDER_NO is null
